name: Files changed opens in Smart Diff order, lock file last and collapsed
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the reviewer-ordered view: Core logic first, Boilerplate last, the seeded package-lock.json grouped as boilerplate and collapsed (its diff body is not rendered), and the seeded review's finding badge present on the file it flagged. Clicking that badge leaves the diff for the Findings tab, at the card it names — the URL carries both, so this is the whole click-through, not just a repaint. Toggling to Original order falls back to the flat viewer. Read-only seeded data — Smart Diff is deterministic and makes no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: load the app root
land on the PR list
open the PR row (by number — the title is CSS-truncated in the list)
navigate to the PR detail route
PR detail data settles
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
smart-diff response settles
the core group renders

cmd: The substance of the change — review closely
steps.label: core group carries its reviewer hint
business logic is on the page
the boilerplate group renders
the lock file is classified as boilerplate
switch back to the unordered diff
the flat viewer still lists the changed files
back to the reviewer order
smart-diff settles again
click the findings badge on the flagged file
the badge switched tabs
…and named the card it jumped to
the Findings panel is what rendered
the card the badge named is expanded — this label exists only inside an open card (uppercased by CSS, see e2e/INSIGHTS.md)
